name: dayan-code-adversary-guard
description: Read-only 3-eye adversarial PR & code reviewer catching concurrency bugs, silent data corruption, auth bypasses, and secret leaks before release.

author.name: 成都大衍千机科技有限公司（雷可扬）

displayDescription.en: Reviews code diffs through 3 adversarial lenses (Saboteur, 6-Month Newcomer, Security Guard) with line-level minimal fixes.
displayDescription.zh: 拒绝AI写完代码轻飘飘说没问题！用生产破坏者、新人维护与安全戍边三副眼镜审代码挡事故。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Run a 3-eye adversarial review on my current git diff before we deploy to production
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 用生产破坏者、半年后新人和安全戍边三视角审查我当前的 git diff，找出阻断级隐患

quickPrompts.en: Run a 3-eye adversarial review on my current git diff before we deploy to production
quickPrompts.zh: 用生产破坏者、半年后新人和安全戍边三视角审查我当前的 git diff，找出阻断级隐患

quickPrompts.en: Audit this API and database transaction logic for partial updates and auth bypasses
quickPrompts.zh: 重点审计这段接口与数据库事务代码是否存在并发半更新、越权访问或密钥硬编码

quickPrompts.en: Evaluate whether our multi-agent architecture can be simplified into deterministic rules
quickPrompts.zh: 评估我们这套复杂的多Agent方案，砍掉伪复杂度并给出带预算熔断的精简架构
